author: Unity
description:
We are excited to announce the experimental release of the UI Toolkit Connector for Figma (com.unity.ui.figma 0.1.0-exp.1) 🎨✨

No more manually rebuilding Figma designs in the Unity Editor line-by-line. Instead of treating your designs like flat reference images, this package lets you push Figma frames straight into Unity as real, editable UXML - and sync the updates you choose back to Figma, manually or automatically.

Before you jump in, please keep in mind that this is an early experimental release (0.1.0-exp.1) meant for testing and feedback, specific package requirements apply so be sure to check the documentation for full setup details.

🔗 Check out the setup guide and join the conversation in our Discussions thread: https://on.unity.com/FigmaUIToolkit_Discussions
